operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Sets shipping details on an existing invoice.

The invoice is identified by the `id` path parameter. Send the shipping fields nested under the `Invoice` object — all are optional, and only the fields you include (with a non-empty value) are applied:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `shipping_option_id` | ID of a shipping option to apply |
| `shipping_amount` | Shipping fee added to the invoice total |
| `shipping_tax_id` | ID of the tax applied to the shipping fee |
| `shipping_number` | Tracking/shipping number, recorded as the invoice's "Shipping Number" custom field |

Empty or `0` values are ignored, so this endpoint can set or overwrite shipping fields but cannot clear them. A request that includes no shipping fields still returns a success response without changing the invoice.

The response is `403` when no invoice matches the given ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The invoice ID to set shipping on.

shipping_option_id.description: ID of a shipping option to apply to the invoice.

shipping_amount.description: Shipping fee added to the invoice total.

shipping_tax_id.description: ID of the tax applied to the shipping fee.

shipping_number.description: Tracking/shipping number. Recorded as the invoice's "Shipping Number" custom field.

Invoice.description: Wrapper object carrying the shipping fields to set. Send only the fields you want to update; all are optional. Empty or `0` values are ignored (a value cannot be cleared through this endpoint).

403.description: No invoice matches the given ID, or it is not accessible.

validation_errors.description: Present only when field-level validation errors exist.
